information_scope: same fixed PT-Z-001; only public active actor schedules; no private opponent hand, deck order or future encounter reveal
ui_diff_scope: v0.9 to v0.10, seven UI source files including new relations.js; build.cjs generates preview
unverified: real browser connector visibility/occlusion, object-window layout, hover travel and slim strip readability
physical hold timing, manual touch scrolling and pinch zoom
human effort, errors and event-feed readability

gesture_policy.motion_before_hold: horizontal browsing regardless of direction; locked until release
gesture_policy.whole_page_vertical_scroll: outside card surfaces; also on cards when drag disabled

presentation.action_anchor: one execution button directly below selected card, clamped inside hand viewport; placement label is 場に出す
presentation.outside_window: pinned menu windows dismiss without background action; object windows permit direct object switching; only hand detail permits explicit execution; hover preview permits normal background input

live_history.location: transient pointer-transparent overlay at field lower right; no reserved layout height

presentation.artwork: provisional elevated view of a broad clearing; distant ground beneath opponents; terrain base + active environment layers + actor/card artwork slots
presentation.hand_background: continuous terrain across entire game screen
presentation.menu_location: slim single-row bottom strip with horizontally scrollable status and menus when needed
presentation.player_status_location: single bottom row, HP first, hand count included
presentation.prediction: faint connectors between actual hand, field and target objects below windows; public numeric prediction/formulas retained in card details
presentation.card_window_height_px: space from 16px below root top to 8px before hand; at least 200px
presentation.adoption: v0.10 corrects diagram location and adds public field/actor inspection; real-device readability remains unverified
presentation.persistent_text: actor/card actionable state and current next-turn icons; no region headings or idle gesture instructions
presentation.help: on-demand operation/settings window; formal tutorial not implemented
presentation.breakthrough: bottom-strip window; current active objectives under fixed replace_environment rules only

action_order.participants: all active actors that act, including player; next action once per actor
action_order.sort: next_at ascending; ties V, P, E, then actor ID
action_order.display: small horizontal artwork/fallback icons plus delay; full names and absolute times on demand
action_order.overflow: horizontal scrolling and conditional previous/next controls
action_order.update: after game state changes; selection does not assume future actions

presentation.card_window_targets: legal active targets selectable within the large inspector
presentation.selection: closing window retains selected card; no explicit deselect button; initial and post-action card selection remains empty
presentation.target: restored fixed PT-Z-001 initial V0, retained while active, otherwise first active displayed participant
presentation.deadline_copy: provisional あとN行動 / 今回まで; own-action decrement explained in details

hover.dismiss: leave trigger and window when peeking; same opener/outside/Esc when pinned
hover.switch: click different opener; hover does not replace pinned content

object_details.field: full public card effects/costs/expiry definition/loss conditions; preserves selected hand
object_details.actor: current public stats, next action, existing behavior and observed card types; click also selects target
object_details.toggle: same object closes, different visible object switches
object_details.internal_target: changes target while retaining card detail

board_connections.layer: above objects, below opaque windows and drag ghost; pointer-transparent

paths.place: hand to empty same-attribute field; no target leg
paths.attack: hand to matching field card to current target
paths.guard_heal_none: hand to matching field card to player status

board_connections.source: actual DOM rectangles clipped to their scrolling viewport
board_connections.update: selection, target, game state, all endpoint scrolling, container resize
board_connections.offscreen: omit segment with fully offscreen endpoint; existing scrolling hints remain
board_connections.window_occlusion: covered segments are hidden; closing window retains selected card and full route
